faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.text: Can't find your answer? Ask us on the free consultation call.

items.q: Do you work with my industry?
items.a: Yes. We work with brands in every industry, from FMCG and textiles to pet brands, food, real estate and more.

items.q: What is the difference between Starter and Pro?
items.a: Both include planning, shooting, editing, Meta ads and a monthly report. Starter is shot on iPhone. Pro is shot on a DSLR camera for a more cinematic look, and comes with a more detailed report.

items.q: Is the ad budget included in the package?
items.a: [Confirm] The ad budget is paid directly to Meta and is separate from our fee. We help you decide how much to spend.
[Confirm] Most brands see better reach and engagement in the first month. Leads and sales usually grow over two to three months as we learn what works.

items.q: Do I need to be present for the shoot?
items.a: Not always. We plan everything with you first, then our crew handles the shoot at your location.
Fill in the form below. We'll call you, understand your goals and suggest the right package.
